title: ANALOGS.NETWORK node manifest
description: One creative's seat on the ring. Fields are core LONG-TERM metadata — chosen to still make sense in ten years. Node numbers are permanent: assigned at merge, never reused; a node that goes offline becomes status 'dark' (a tombstone that keeps its number), it is never deleted.

node.description: Permanent ring position, assigned at merge (join order IS ring order). Never reused.

slug.description: Stable lowercase identifier. Matches the filename: nodes/{NNN}-{slug}.json

name.description: Display name, as it should read on the ring.

url.description: The node's own corner of the web. HTTPS only.

disciplines.description: Primary discipline first — it sets the node's light color on the ring.

est.description: YYYY-MM-DD the node joined the ring (day precision: the card's DAY n badge and the FIRST LIGHT afterglow both derive from it; display renders YYYY.MM).

status.description: 'dark' is a tombstone: the socket goes inert but keeps its number. Set by maintainers, not by PR authors.

founding.description: First cohort. White-hot core on the ring. Set by maintainers.

links.description: Optional extra links shown IN the node's card — a creative's other projects/sites. One light per creative: the primary `url` stays the node's identity (sets the ring color and the callsign); these are secondary references. Capped at 4 so cards stay legible.

button.description: Optional 88x31 button (the old web's handshake) other nodes may display.

feed.description: Optional RSS/Atom feed — reserved for a future 'fresh signal' indicator.
